#+title: Test fixtures

- =goals-iris-spinlock.json= :: The result of =Lean.Widget.getInteractiveGoals=
  in =Iris/HeapLang/Lib/SpinLock.lean= of [[https://github.com/leanprover-community/iris-lean][iris-lean]]
  (commit =82c3988=, Lean 4.34.1) at line 110, inside =newlock_spec=, with RPC
  wire format v1: 3 goals and 66 references.  The goal text is derived from
  iris-lean, which is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0; see
  =../../nael/LICENSE.APACHE2=.
- =interactive-diagnostics.json= :: The result of
  =Lean.Widget.getInteractiveDiagnostics= for the whole of
  =Iris/HeapLang/Lib/SpinLock.lean= of iris-lean (same commit and Lean
  version), with a few lines appended in the server's memory only: a
  =set_option trace.Meta.synthInstance true in= example, an example
  proved by =exact?=, and a =#check=.  The server ran with
  =silentDiagnosticSupport= and =hasWidgets=, so it contains silent
  "Goals accomplished!" messages, a trace with lazy children, and a "Try
  this" widget (=Lean.Meta.Hint.textInsertionWidget=).  Derived from
  iris-lean, which is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0; see
  =../../nael/LICENSE.APACHE2=.

Both are derived from =Iris/HeapLang/Lib/SpinLock.lean=, whose header names
its authors:

#+begin_example
Copyright (c) The Iris-Lean Contributors
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Michael Sammler, Fernando Leal, Klaus Kraßnitzer
#+end_example
